name: travel-records
description: Recover and reconcile travel records from authorized mail and documents.

interface.longDescription: Reconstruct hotel stays, flight segments and dining reservations from authorized mail and documents. Review dates, status, spending and source evidence; keep cancellations and unresolved items visible. Desktop preview requiring local Python 3.9+ execution, a writable private workspace and jsonschema; setup checks resources and can prepare an isolated dependency environment. Gmail access requires a separately authorized host connector; supplied documents also work. Annual requests inspect only mail sent in the requested years. Real-mail evaluation is limited and mainly covers hotels. Web, mobile and unattended continuation are unverified. Review CSV and JSON independently; optional FotoNest v1 import currently requires a Debug build.
defaultPrompt: 整理我 2026 年邮件中的旅行记录。
继续上次的旅行记录核对。

publication.release_notes: Initial desktop preview submission package with bundled travel reconciliation skills, setup checks and source-backed review outputs. Public directory availability depends on review and publication.

zh-CN.subtitle: 从邮件和账单整理旅行记录
zh-CN.description: 从已授权邮箱和资料整理住宿、航班及餐饮预订，核对日期、状态、金额和来源，保留取消与待复核项。桌面预览版依赖本地 Python 3.9+、可写私有工作区和 jsonschema，首次设置会检查环境并可准备隔离依赖。Gmail 需通过宿主单独授权，也可提供少量文件。年度请求仅检查指定年份发送的邮件。真实验证范围有限，以酒店材料为主；网页、手机及无人值守续跑尚未验收。CSV 和核对 JSON 可独立使用；可选 FotoNest v1 导入当前需要 Debug 构建。
